welcome.title:
What if your AI
actually understood
who you are?
welcome.description: An AI that builds a knowledge graph from your conversations — so it learns who you are, not just what you said last.
welcome.regularBot: Have you tried deep breaths or going for a walk?
welcome.synapseBot: The last three times you felt this, it followed tense interactions with David. Did something happen today?

pipeline.title:
Memory engineering,
not memorization
pipeline.description: Four steps from conversation to structured knowledge.

steps.title: Converse
steps.desc: Talk about your day, your goals, your worries. Every session is captured.

steps.title: Ingest
steps.desc: Entities and relationships are extracted into a knowledge graph.

steps.title: Compile
steps.desc: Your graph is injected into future sessions as structured context.

steps.title: Evolve
steps.desc: Each conversation refines the graph. The more you talk, the better it gets.

compass.name: Compass
compass.subtitle: Therapeutic companion — neuroaffirmative by default
compass.approach: Maps your emotional patterns across conversations. Connects today's anxiety to recurring triggers. Never minimizes, never defaults to toxic positivity.
useCases: Processing recurring anxiety, grief, or anger with full pattern awareness
Tracking your nervous system states and window of tolerance over time

solace.name: Solace
solace.subtitle: Wellbeing companion — reflective, not prescriptive
solace.approach: A gentle, unhurried space for emotional reflection. Notices shifts in your mood and energy over time. Like a calm conversation over tea.
useCases: Daily emotional check-ins without the pressure of "doing therapy"
Tracking what brings you joy, flow, or calm — and being reminded when you forget
Building emotional literacy: naming what you feel so you can work with it

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.subtitle: Growth coach — direct, honest, action-oriented
momentum.approach: Holds you accountable to your goals — and knows what actually derails you. Direct and clear, no fluff. Respects that rest is a strategy, not a failure.
useCases: Setting and tracking goals with someone who remembers your commitments
Breaking through procrastination by identifying your specific triggers
Getting honest feedback — not cheerleading — when you're avoiding something

cta.title:
The conversation
that remembers
cta.description: Start talking. The graph builds itself. The AI gets better the more you use it.
cta.demoNote: Explore with a pre-built account — no sign-up needed.
